task_completion.description: NREL System Advisor Model (SAM) is opened and a new project is initiated.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SAM application window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The weather data/location is set to Phoenix, Arizona.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Location and Resource' page shows 'Phoenix' or a Phoenix-area TMY file selected in the library.

task_completion.description: The DC system size is configured to approximately 5 kW.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page shows a 'Nameplate capacity' or 'System DC size' between 4.5 and 5.5 kW.

task_completion.description: The roof slope (tilt) is set to ~20 degrees and orientation (azimuth) is set to south-facing.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'System Design' page shows Tilt between 15-25 degrees and Azimuth between 175-185 degrees (180 is south).

task_completion.description: The simulation is run to generate energy production results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Results' page is visible, showing a 'Summary' with 'Annual energy' values.

task_completion.description: The results are saved to the specific JSON file path requested.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal window shows the file 'Phoenix_Residential_5kW.json' exists in '/home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/'.

integrity.description: The agent used the SAM GUI to configure the system rather than just writing a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with SAM input fields and the 'Simulate' button.

integrity.description: The annual energy production is derived from the SAM simulation results, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the final JSON file match the 'Annual energy' (kWh) displayed in the SAM Results GUI.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the process of entering parameters and clicking 'Save' or 'Export' within the application.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The system must be 5 kW DC (acceptable range 4.5-5.5 kW). Location must be Phoenix, AZ. Tilt must be ~20 degrees (acceptable 15-25). Azimuth must be south-facing (acceptable 175-185 degrees). The final output must be a JSON file named 'Phoenix_Residential_5kW.json' located in '/home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/'. Annual energy production for such a system in Phoenix is typically between 8,000 and 10,000 kWh.
